recordModel.start: the 64-hex node digest, a label of at most 70 characters (already at the schema maximum in every measured log), the phase, seq and tUs
recordModel.end: the node, phase, outcome, durationUs, tUs, seq and xfail
recordModel.growth: sizes grow only by digits: seq gains a sixth digit after 99,999 (the cap allows 140,000), and tUs and durationUs reach at most 10 digits inside the 1200 s verify cap
recordModel.acceptance: a non-control record is written only while events_written + 1 + 2 <= event_limit and bytes_written + len(record) + 2 * MAX_RECORD_BYTES <= byte_limit; SESSION_END (control) is written without the reserve
recordModel.digits: the 900 s worker deadline keeps the parent's tUs below 1e9 us (9 digits), assuming collection, the three PARENT_NODES and finish fit in the remaining 100 s; the 6 x 900 s duration budget over the roughly 68,700 END records of a full run averages under 100,000 us (5 digits), which bounds the mean, not each record's digit count (C3-1)

profileRules: Each profile is driven through the module's own Diagnostics with its default limits (as conftest.py constructs it), a counting sink and finish(0), with three START/END pairs per test.
The clock's first call returns 0.0 (the origin); its n-th call returns 100.0 + n x 1e-6 s, so every tUs after the first record has exactly 9 digits.

W and R node ids give the 70-character label test_xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx.py[:32]::test_yyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyy; S's x::y[i] gives the label <redacted-node>; %d is the test's index from 0.
